answer: Each epoch a randomness beacon publishes challenge words like hollow, basalt, ivory. To stay active an agent must sign a short response that meaningfully uses exactly those words in its current task context before the epoch closes. Since the words are unknown until emission, no attacker can precompute template answers in bulk: every sybil identity needs a fresh generation pass per epoch, turning one-time scripting into a recurring per-identity compute bill, and hollow responses that dodge the challenge forfeit reputation stake, making fake identity marginally unprofitable.
